judge_blinding: Use randomized opaque arm IDs, raw returned text, original synthetic source conversation and relevant gold. Do not expose engine identity, expected winner, rank hints or other arms. Score before unblinding.
answer_prompt: Answer only from the supplied recent conversation and retrieved memory or recap. Preserve project and time distinctions. If the value is unknown, deleted, cancelled or undecided, say so; do not invent it. Return JSON mapping question IDs to concise answers in the question language.

answer_fields.correct: true only when all required propositions are semantically supported and no forbidden current proposition is affirmed
answer_fields.unsupported: true when any asserted factual answer lacks support in the supplied evidence
answer_fields.abstained: true when requested value is not supplied; correct only when gold requires unknown/deleted/unresolved
answer_fields.critical_reversal: true for changed quantity/date/name, reversed negation, treating cancellation as active, or assigning a value to unresolved state
answer_fields.evidence_quotes: short exact spans from answer/retrieval and gold proposition IDs; never infer correctness from engine label

memory_denominators.answer_correctness: All query rows flagged answer_correctness; transport failures remain in intended denominator and score incorrect, with separate execution-failure count.
memory_denominators.current_answer_correctness_gate: Query rows flagged current_at_k only; report overall and each language. Also publish all-query correctness so history/deletion failures remain visible.
memory_denominators.current_at_1: Rows flagged current_at_k: first retrieved item supports all required current proposition components; no-memory has empty retrieval and scores zero.
memory_denominators.current_at_5: Rows flagged current_at_k: union of the first five items supports the required current proposition; annotate multi-fact requirements.
memory_denominators.stale_exposure: Flagged latest-mode query rows with at least one stale/false replacement asserted as current in retrieved context. Clearly marked valid history is reported separately.
memory_denominators.deletion_leakage: Flagged query rows where a deleted secret/value is reproduced even in a denial, or a cancelled commitment is asserted active. A cancellation statement without forbidden secret text is appropriate, not leakage.
memory_denominators.project_leakage: Flagged query rows containing an item sourced only from another project without cross-project authorization. Correct answer content does not excuse leaked retrieval.
memory_denominators.false_overwrite: Flagged rows where the gold preserved fact is absent from native active state after ingestion/reopen and an unsupported replacement is active. Retrieval miss alone is NOT false overwrite; report native-state measurement unavailable when no provenance is exposed.
memory_denominators.critical_reversal: Flagged rows with reversal in retrieved current context or final answer; report those two surfaces separately.

compression_denominators.retention: Ten declared current gold propositions in the 16-message head per conversation. Each gets 1 only if the summary explicitly or unambiguously entails it; omissions and contradictions get 0. History may be retained if clearly historical.
compression_denominators.fabrication: Judge every assertion in the summary against the entire head, not just the ten gold facts. Unsupported incidental and critical assertions are separate counts.
compression_denominators.downstream_correctness: Three binary questions per conversation. A question is correct only when every required proposition is answered and no contradictory/unsupported value is asserted.
compression_denominators.compression_ratio: Actual model-tokenizer summary tokens divided by actual head tokens, excluding shared tail from both. Report tail and complete downstream prompt tokens separately.
compression_denominators.llm_success: Nonempty summary PLUS confirmed successful provider response receipt. Deterministic fallback text, errors and missing receipts cannot count as actual LLM success.

uncertain_policy: Uncertain labels remain visible and count as non-success for acceptance metrics; no selective retry/rejudge. Publish count and reasons.
prohibited_shortcuts: gold/expected-answer injection into extraction, embeddings, memory engine, summarizer or downstream answer prompt
